title: Optimized Arc
description: Optimized Arc is a lightweight, next-generation optimization modpack built on Fabric. It is carefully designed to maximize your FPS.
body:
**Optimized Arc - Ultimate Performance & FPS Boost**

Optimized Arc is a lightweight performance modpack built on Fabric. It’s designed to do one thing perfectly: maximize your FPS, eliminate stuttering, and give you the smoothest Minecraft experience possible without changing the vanilla feel.

Seriously, whether you're playing on a high-end gaming PC or a literal potato that cries when you look at a jungle biome, this pack will make your game run at its absolute potential.

Features:

Huge FPS Boost: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore to reduce RAM usage and save your PC from exploding.

Shaders Ready: Comes with Iris Shaders pre-installed so you can actually run shaders without turning your PC into a space heater.

Smart Culling: Mods like Entity Culling and More Culling ensure your GPU doesn't waste power rendering things you can't even see. Goodbye lag!

Quality of Life: Includes JEI for easy crafting recipes and Simple Voice Chat so you can scream at your friends in multiplayer.

100% Client-Side: Everything runs locally on your PC. You can use this pack to join any completely vanilla multiplayer server with zero issues.

Complete Modlist:

Cloth Config API (Configuration library for mods)

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine - C2ME (Speeds up chunk loading)

Continuity (Connected textures support)

Dynamic FPS (Lowers resource usage when you alt-tab to watch YouTube)

Entity Culling (Skips rendering hidden entities to boost FPS)

Essential Mod (Easy world sharing with friends and cosmetics)

Fabric API (Core library required for most Fabric mods)

Fast IP Ping (Optimizes server connection pings)

FerriteCore (Drastically reduces RAM usage)

ImmediatelyFast (Optimizes UI and text rendering speed)

Iris Shaders (Modern and fast shader pack support)

Just Enough Items - JEI (Item and recipe viewer)

Krypton (Optimizes network stack and reduces server lag)

Lithium (General physics and world optimization)

Maptip (Shows handy map tooltips)

Mod Menu (Adds a clean screen to view your installed mods)

More Culling (Changes how hidden blocks are rendered for extra FPS)

Simple Voice Chat (Proximity voice chat for multiplayer)

Sodium (The ultimate rendering engine replacement for massive FPS)

Sodium Extra (Adds more visual settings to tweak for performance)
